entry.title: New: dsh-dynamic-wallpaper
entry.summary: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence. Exact install spec: github:willmylife/dsh-dynamic-wallpaper. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
